No outreach, discovery resubmission, accounts, spending or new inventory. Preserve the 22 November SQLite verdict and all existing observation and mandatory retirement obligations. Complete with the actual lease and a lesson after reading saved evidence. Preparation and review establish neither acquisition nor revenue.
